note: Synthetic-profile study. Labels are the author's binary relevance labels for 36 author-written profiles. Features are derived from the same matching the formula uses. Results measure agreement with those labels, not real-world career-guidance quality.

protocol.inner: GroupKFold(3) by profile, GridSearchCV scoring average_precision
protocol.outer: StratifiedGroupKFold(5) by profile, strata = primary category
protocol.per_profile_metric: mean over repeats, then macro mean over scorable profiles
protocol.ranking: careers sorted by predicted probability, ties by career id
protocol.test: paired sign-flip randomisation vs formula, 10000 resamples, Holm over models
protocol.threshold: F1-maximising threshold chosen on each outer training fold
